title: Absorb one section error and one global tail (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

One section error `p^6 exp(-p^2)` and one global tail `p^{10} exp(-p^2)` add to `p^6 (1 + p^4) exp(-p^2)`. Under the same four-bit gate,

```text
g (9 p^2)^{g-1} p^6 (1 + p^4) exp(K p - p^2) < 2^{-C p}
```

for integers `p ≥ 2`, `g ≥ 1`, `K ≥ 0` and `C ≥ 0`, whenever `p ≥ max(64, 4K + 2C)` and `16 g ceil(log2 p) ≤ p`.

The factor `1 + p^4` contributes `4 L + 1`. It is strictly below `2^{4 L + 1}`, and at `p = 2` it is `17`, which is not below `2^{4 L}`. Eight times the new exponent is at most `-8`, so the exponent is at most `-C p - 1`. Four bits still majorize 9. At `g = p^2` the monomial is greater than 1.

Both tails and the ceiling `9 p^2` stay hypotheses. This package does not prove `||H^{-1}||_2 ≤ p^{10}`. No new κ. The selected record remains `23/10000`.

- [x] Prints `PASS_GAUSSIAN_UNEQUAL_GATE` and `outcome=completed`
